content.text:
Now `applyPauseState` already toggles `body.paused` based on `document.hidden || manuallyPaused`, so reusing it for the `visibilitychange` listener removes the duplicated logic and also keeps the pause button/label in sync when the tab is hidden/restored.

Two changes made to `0.html`:
1. Removed the redundant `<title>` inside the SVG and added `aria-hidden="true"` — the parent button already has a full `aria-label`, so the nested title risked screen readers announcing the description twice.
2. Replaced the inline `visibilitychange` handler with a call to the existing `applyPauseState()` function, eliminating duplicated toggle logic and keeping ARIA state consistent when tab visibility changes.
